title: Audit consistency of Engram working-rule memories
outcome: Audit consistency of Engram working-rule memories
acceptance: A concise audit result distinguishes actual contradictions from scoped exceptions and identifies concrete corrections without inventing authority.
Conflicting, stale or ambiguous working rules are compared against current direct user instructions and repository rules, with exact memory keys and justified classifications.
Current project memories are inventoried and read, with failed reads and concurrent changes disclosed.

completion.summary: Audited all58 current memory heads, recovered concurrent revisions, compared rule conflicts against direct user instructions and repository sources, and recorded exact findings/corrections with scope and evidence limits. Independent evaluation passed3/3. Later standing-approval memory correction is separately attributed; the audit does not claim every remaining inconsistency is repaired.
